cohort: The study included 230 women with triplet pregnancies that resulted in three live babies.
finding: Obstetrical and neonatal outcomes were similar for triplets conceived spontaneously versus via ART, despite overall high rates of preterm birth and related complications in triplet gestations.
followup_time: Prior to hospital discharge for neonatal mortality; at birth for other outcomes.
birth_weight: Mean 1655 +- 550 g for infants born after 24 weeks
